q1.question: How do I know if an egg is still good?
q1.answer: An egg can be safely consumed up to 28 days after laying. EggscuseMe tracks this for you and tells you exactly which cooking method is best at each freshness stage.

q2.question: What's the difference between 'use by' and 'best before'?
q2.answer: The recommended consumption date is typically 28 days after laying. The date on boxes is often shorter as a precaution from distributors. EggscuseMe uses the actual laying date for accurate tracking.

q3.question: Can I eat raw eggs?
q3.answer: Yes, but only within the first 9 days after laying (extra-fresh). After that, prefer cooking methods that heat the yolk well, like fried or hard-boiled.

q4.question: How does the freshness color code work?
q4.answer: Green (0-9 days): Extra-fresh, perfect for soft-boiled or raw. Yellow (10-21 days): Fresh, ideal for omelette or fried. Orange (22-28 days): Cook thoroughly, best hard-boiled. Gray (29+ days): Expired, discard.

q5.question: Can I share my fridge with my family?
q5.answer: Yes! EggscuseMe supports organizations. Share your virtual fridge with family or roommates. Everyone can add, consume, and track eggs together.

q6.question: Is there a free plan?
q6.answer: Yes! The free plan lets you track up to 2 egg boxes with basic features. Premium unlocks unlimited boxes, detailed statistics, and notifications.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Protecting your personal data is at the heart of our concerns.

dataCollected.title: Data Collected
dataCollected.content:
We collect the following data:
- Identification data (Name, Email) during registration.
- Usage data (Fridge inventory, consumption history).
- Technical data (IP address, browser type) for security and statistics purposes.

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.content:
Your data is used to:
- Provide and manage the Service.
- Send you freshness notifications (if enabled).
- Improve our features through anonymized statistics.

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing
dataSharing.content: We do not sell your personal data. It may be shared with third-party providers only for the proper functioning of the service (hosting, email delivery).

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.content: In accordance with GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, and delete your data. You can exercise these rights directly in your account settings or by contacting us.

security.title: Security
security.content: We implement all necessary technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or alteration.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to EggscuseMe. By using our application, you agree to these Terms of Service.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.content: These Terms of Service define the terms and conditions for using the EggscuseMe application, hereinafter referred to as "the Service", and the conditions of use by the User.

access.title: Access to the Service
access.content:
The Service is freely accessible to any User with internet access. All costs related to accessing the Service, whether hardware, software, or internet access fees, are solely the responsibility of the user.

Some features are reserved for Premium subscribers (Brigade or Chef plans).

personalData.title: Personal Data
personalData.content: EggscuseMe is committed to ensuring that the collection and processing of your data, carried out through the site, comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). For more information, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: Trademarks, logos, signs, and all site content (texts, images, sounds...) are protected by intellectual property law and copyright in particular.

liability.title: Liability
liability.content: Information provided on the application (including freshness dates and cooking advice) is for informational purposes only. The user remains solely responsible for verifying the quality of the food they consume. EggscuseMe cannot be held liable for any health issues related to egg consumption.

modifications.title: Modifications to Terms
modifications.content: EggscuseMe reserves the right to modify these terms and conditions at any time. Users are advised to regularly check the latest version of the Terms of Service available on the site.

items.question: How do you calculate freshness?
items.answer: We use the laying date you provide. An egg is extra-fresh up to 9 days, fresh up to 21 days, and should be cooked thoroughly between 22 and 28 days.
